title: Compare accepted changes including downstream effort
method: Synthetic equal-scope comparison. Totals are implementation + review + correction: 24+6+3, 18+9+4, and 20+6+2 hours. No named product or empirical improvement is implied; later maintenance is outside this example.
alt: Compare accepted changes including downstream effort. Baseline: 33 person-hours for 12 tasks, Candidate A: 31 person-hours for 12 tasks, Candidate B: 28 person-hours for 12 tasks. Illustrative data.
